data: Amazon's operating income rose by roughly 117% between fiscal 2023 and fiscal 2025. In fiscal 2023 the company reported operating income of about $36.9 billion. In fiscal 2025 it reported about $80.0 billion. That figure absorbed one-time charges in the third quarter, including a $2.5 billion FTC settlement and about $1.8 billion in severance costs. The increase of roughly $43 billion more than doubled the company's operating profit over the two years, with fiscal 2024 at about $68.6 billion along the way. Amazon Web Services and the higher-margin advertising business drove much of the growth. These figures come from my training data rather than a live lookup, so check them against Amazon's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K before relying on them.
